The source returns 'Program ended without M2/M30 or percent delimiters', and the result JSON shows 264 failures with returncode 1 on valid snippet-style programs. That public-contract mismatch explains the complete failure of parameter expressions, position tracking, active G-code/M-code state, cutter-radius compensation, canned cycles, tooling, G92, G10 coordinate offsets, G28/G30, and probing suites despite nontrivial implementation work. Secondary gaps in tests not blocked by termination include parameter file output and loaded-parameter trace state, incorrect trace error line numbers and completed-block entries, missing nullable trace fields, missing CRC and nonmodal labels in trace output, and weak trace handling for G28/G30/G53/G92.2, full arcs, probing, and canned cycles.
